x: Newson competing in his second race, was 7th in the very good time of 61.33 and shows promise of being a real asset. The handicap was won by another new member Dough Fotheringham in 63.03 (7.10),C.McLennon was second in 64.28 (8.30) and Newson 3rd (5.0).
All the good peerformances were too numerous to give in detail, but briefly Hall, Phillips, Demmon, Middleton, Eglington Newson and Scamell all beat the hour and were awarded their 7 miles badges.

Hugh McGreechan was 3rd in the scratch race in 2 hrs. 34mins.44secs., our "A" Team - McGreechan Newson and Eglington - won the handicap team race, the "B" Team - Rolfe Wilson and Doubleday - were 2nd; Bernard Eglington (22.0) won the individual handicap, and Fred Rolfe (28.0) was 2nd in fact it is r…
George Beecham gained his first National winning team medal, Hugh McGreechan the Sydney Bayliss Cup and Bob Newson his first (2nd Class) National Standard medal.

Not disheartened, the other lads walked exceptionally well and with Eric Hall 11th, George Checkley 16th, Len Demmon 18th and Bob Newson 28th we totalled 68 points to finish 3rd to Woodford Green 21 points, with Met.
A nice exhibition of packing by Len Demmon 16th, Bob Newson 18th and George Checkley 19th, with a tolal of 53 points, once again secured us 3rd place.
We actually started two full teams and a depleted third and our "A" Team of James, Hall, Checkley and Newson were 3rd to Highgate with 38 points.
Our other lads had been going well and at 5 miles Newson was 13th, Demmon (later disqualified) 16th and Ted Smith 31st, with the remainder of the lads moving up well.

After some early dashes to the front, a group, including Checkley and Newson, settled down in the lead. George Checkley walked really well to win in 40m.12s. with Bob Newson second, Syd James (whom we are pleased to see out again) third and Eric Froude, still improving, fourth.
Ted Smith was our first man home in (10th) followed by McMullen, Checkley and Newson, 12th, 15th and 16th. We thus finished 2nd in the Scratch Race despite not having our 2 Olympic men.
Ted Smith,showing his true form,was 4th,Syd James 12th, Checkley 5th.McMullen 7th and Newson 13th.After this we can hope to regain the Berman Cup in our own Open on Nov24th.
